TaskDesc_EN: Display characters, pictures, and effects using Bitmap/Sprite and layered Viewports.
CommonPitfalls_EN: Forgetting to dispose Bitmaps/Sprites; z-order conflicts; updating sprites without Graphics.update.
RMXP_IntegrationNotes_EN: Use in Scene_* and SpriteSet_* patterns; store sprites in instance vars and dispose on scene end.

TaskDesc_EN: Create UI panels with Window, draw text to contents Bitmap, and configure fonts/colors.
CommonPitfalls_EN: Not clearing window contents; mismanaging font state; forgetting to dispose window contents.
RMXP_IntegrationNotes_EN: Follow Window_Base conventions; keep draw calls centralized (refresh).

TaskDesc_EN: Poll keyboard/gamepad input states and convert them into actions.
CommonPitfalls_EN: Using triggers where repeat is needed; not calling Input.update each frame.
RMXP_IntegrationNotes_EN: Call Input.update within the main update loop; keep mappings consistent.

TaskDesc_EN: Play and control background music and sound effects.
CommonPitfalls_EN: Overlapping BGM/ME; missing fade-outs on transitions.
RMXP_IntegrationNotes_EN: Centralize audio changes in scene transitions; prefer fadeout on map transfer.

TaskDesc_EN: Control frame updates, transitions, screen effects, and timing.
CommonPitfalls_EN: Long waits without updating Graphics; mismatched transition timings.
RMXP_IntegrationNotes_EN: Use Graphics.transition/freeze patterns; always keep update loop alive during waits.

TaskDesc_EN: Load and reuse bitmaps from project folders to avoid repeated IO and memory churn.
CommonPitfalls_EN: Caching too many unique bitmaps; forgetting to clear cache on context changes.
RMXP_IntegrationNotes_EN: Use RPG::Cache for common sprites; clear cache on major scene unload if needed.

TaskDesc_EN: Work with RPG module serialized data: Map, Event, MoveRoute, Troop, etc.
CommonPitfalls_EN: Confusing RPG::* data with runtime Game_* objects.
RMXP_IntegrationNotes_EN: Use RPG::* for editor data; use Game_* for live state; keep conversions explicit.

TaskDesc_EN: Drive simple weather visuals like rain/snow/storm.
CommonPitfalls_EN: Overusing particle counts; forgetting to update/dispose weather objects.
RMXP_IntegrationNotes_EN: Tie weather update/dispose to map spriteset lifecycle.
